title: Domain Pack: Finance / Payment Flow
summary: Finance domain-specific test considerations for payment, transaction, account, authentication, compliance, audit, settlement, refund, fraud detection. States: transaction initiated, payment pending/authorized/captured/failed/refunded, settlement pending/completed/failed, account active/suspended/closed/frozen. Risk hotspots: payment/settlement state divergence, double capture/refund, partial refund excess, authentication bypass, compliance check skipped, fraud detection imbalance, timeout duplicate, currency rounding errors.
risks: Payment state and settlement state divergence
